sn1.23:1.1: The “tangle” (_jaṭā_) is the tangled hair or dreadlocks of the Brahmanical _jaṭila_ ascetics, as is made clear in [sn7.6]() where such an ascetic opens with the same verse. The assertion is that such ascetics are as tangled in their minds as they are in their hair.
sn1.23:2.1: This verse serves as the key to the entire Visuddhimagga. In a daring literary conceit, that vast compendium positions itself as an explanation of this single verse.
